**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2022/07/10 (Sun) 11:27
- [USER] User requested help to organize an abstract into a 30-minute PowerPoint presentation.
- [USER] The abstract topic is "Fluid HMI: Designing an intuitive HMI for water and wastewater treatment processes."
- [FACT] User mentioned that there are many ways to develop a water or wastewater SCADA to control a plant process.
- [FACT] User stated that High-Performance HMI has made a push in the industry.
- [FACT] User noted that implementing High-Performance HMI can present challenges regarding employee training.
- [FACT] User indicated that High-Performance HMI fails to consider someone new to a treatment process.
- [FACT] User mentioned that High-Performance HMI may not be immediately intuitive for field workers.
- [FACT] User introduced another approach to HMI design involving both a 3D realistic view and a P&ID view.
- [FACT] User stated that this type of implementation can create an HMI that feels familiar to operators while maintaining situational awareness.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Slide 1: Introduction - Introduce the topic of fluid HMI and its importance in water and wastewater treatment processes; provide a brief overview of the presentation structure.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Slide 2: Overview of SCADA systems - Provide a brief overview of SCADA systems and their importance in water and wastewater treatment processes; discuss challenges associated with developing an effective SCADA system.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Slide 3: High-Performance HMI - Define High-Performance HMI and explain its benefits; discuss challenges associated with implementing High-Performance HMI and issues it presents for employee training.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Slide 4: Intuitive HMI design - Introduce the concept of intuitive HMI design; explain the importance of designing an HMI that is immediately understandable for operators in the field.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Slide 5: Fluid HMI design - Introduce the concept of Fluid HMI design; discuss how it combines a 3D realistic view and a P&ID view to create an intuitive HMI that is visually familiar to operators.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Slide 6: Benefits of Fluid HMI - Discuss benefits of Fluid HMI design, including improved situational awareness and operator understanding; highlight potential for increased productivity and reduced errors.
